name: Stinkface Surprise
source: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun

stealth.note: (expert; @Check[perception|dc:31] to detect the hidden bypass button)

description: A pile of excrement and rotten food is launched at whoever opens the trunk without first depressing a hidden button on the side of the trunk.
disable: DC 26 Thievery (expert) to unhook the launch spring

offensiveAbilities.name: Stinkface Surprise
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature opens the trunk or breaks open the trunk; Bypass Hidden button

Effect The trap deals (4d10+22) Poison Damage damage to the triggering creature (Basic DC 26 Fortitude Saving Throw save). On a failure, the target is additionally Blinded and Sickened 4. A creature can spend one Interact action to scrub the filth from their eyes, removing the blinded condition. A creature can't reduce the value of their sickened condition below 1 until they fully wash the filth off, a process which requires 5 minutes and suitable supplies.
